name: vibedigest-video-intake
description: Reliable video context extraction for Codex agents using VibeDigest transcript, caption, and ASR fallback workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Extract video metadata, transcripts, timestamps, and Markdown for agents.
interface.longDescription: Use VibeDigest Video Intake when Codex needs reliable video context from a URL. The plugin routes through a local MCP server and a credential-aware gateway that tries provider transcripts, direct captions, and optional ASR without storing secrets in the plugin package.
defaultPrompt: Use VibeDigest to get the full context for this video URL.
Extract a timestamped transcript and Markdown notes from this YouTube link.
Get reliable video context before summarizing this lecture.
